channel.title: thenitishkr.in articles and evidence records
channel.description: Article 12, DISHA, digital constitutional personhood, and intelligence case records from thenitishkr.in.

item.title: What If the Citizen Was Never the Centre of Digital India?
item.description: Public-interest investigation into Digital India's citizen-centricity gap — how the citizen appears in every database but vanishes at the point of remedy, with documentary analysis and constitutional accountability questions.

item.title: Follow the Data: W.P.(Crl.) 163/2026 and MeitY Record
item.description: Evidence record for W.P.(Crl.) No. 163/2026: Supreme Court direction to MeitY on Indian citizens' data held on foreign servers, disposed 19 May 2026, with petition text, court order, and digital governance analysis.

item.title: When the Certificate Outran the Ground: NITI Aayog Case
item.description: Case record on NITI Aayog certification and fund accountability — where scheme certificates outran ground-level delivery, with RTI-traceable evidence of discrepancy between reported and actual outcomes.

item.title: SIR Was Necessary: Why the Process Was Unconstitutional
item.description: Analysis of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) electoral roll process — the procedural burden-reversal argument, constitutional accountability questions, and the Supreme Court's May 2026 ruling upholding the Election Commission's authority to conduct SIR.

item.title: Article 12 Infected: How Citizens Became Invisible
item.description: Research record examining how digital government systems exercise state-equivalent power over citizen data, rights, and remedy outside Article 12's traditional scope, with constitutional accountability analysis and DISHA framework context.

item.title: Digital Constitutional Personhood: Data Sovereignty for India
item.description: Framework record for Digital Constitutional Personhood — Nitish Kumar's proposed doctrine of data sovereignty and citizen identity in India's digital governance systems, with DISHA architectural context and constitutional analysis.

item.title: DISHA Intelligence Architecture: Evidence, Memory and Constitutional Intelligence
item.description: Whitepaper and evidence architecture record for DISHA (Defence Intelligence Signals Heuristic Architecture v4.2.0) — a public-interest civic intelligence framework for constitutional accountability, cyber evidence, and public records in India.

item.title: The Empty Vault: NDMA Disaster-Fund Accountability Case
item.description: Case 01 evidence record on NDMA disaster-fund accountability — W.P.(Crl.) No. 394/2025, SDRF/NDRF fund utilisation, missing CAG utilisation certificates, and Article 12 responsibility analysis.

item.title: The Sanitation Mirage: ODF False Justification Case
item.description: Case record on ODF (Open Defecation Free) false certification — analysis of scheme declarations outpacing ground reality, with CAG audit material, field records, and constitutional accountability questions.
